repos_data.description: Go package that turns any hex color or string into a ready-to-use 16-color terminal palette.
This is a repository of themes for GNU ls (configured via GNU dircolors) that support Ethan Schoonover’s Solarized color scheme.
A delicate dircolors theme for ls that injects color without overwhelming your workspace - macOS friendly 
Terminal, filesystem, and background-job tools for Claude Desktop on Linux. Zero-dependency MCP extension, MIT-licensed.

repo_meta_data.description: Gogh is a collection of color schemes for various terminal emulators, including Gnome Terminal, Pantheon Terminal, Tilix, and XFCE4 Terminal also compatible with iTerm on macOS. (https://gogh-co.github.io/Gogh/)
